answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Verified soil association membership with organic certifier attestation. It demands a membership the certifier renews after farm audits, and the jetty is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a membership the certifier renews after farm audits stays private; the marble is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The signal is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
